name: forge-mesh
title: FORGE-MESH — procedural 3D modeler + rasterizer
description: Build FORGE-MESH: a pure-Python procedural 3D modeler that generates a 3D mesh (a low-poly terrain from a noise heightfield), exports it as mesh.obj (Wavefront OBJ) and mesh.stl (STL), and rasterizes a shaded preview of it into preview.ppm using only the standard library (write the PPM and a minimal OBJ/STL writer yourself). Running main.py must produce non-empty mesh.obj, mesh.stl and preview.ppm and print FORGE:PASS.
context: Heightfield 32x32 over a 10x10 plane from value noise (implement your own hash-based noise; no numpy). Generate quads, emit OBJ vertices v x y z, faces f, and binary STL triangles. Rasterize: perspective project with a camera, painter's-algorithm sort by depth, flat shade by face normal dot a light dir. Write P3 PPM 320x200. Standard library only.

manifest.purpose: heightfield -> vertices/faces; OBJ and STL writers
manifest.ports: def build_terrain(size); def write_obj(...); def write_stl(...)

manifest.purpose: camera, projection, painter's sort, flat shading, PPM writer
orchestrates generate -> obj/stl -> preview -> print FORGE:PASS; imports noise, mesh, raster
